game.name: Madden Nfl 12 (USA, Europe)
game.desc: Madden NFL 12 is an American football simulation for Xbox 360. It features a collision system that allows the player to take full control of the impacts as well as a Franchise mode that includes an extended roster management with more than 75 players. In addition, the software offers the possibility to create your own playbook and to participate in Superstar, Ultimate Team or Madden Moments Live modes.
